source.name: FC Dallas – 'FC Dallas Unveils New "DNA Kit" Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: UT Southwestern Medical Center remains the front-of-jersey partner for the Inferno Kit.

source.name: FC Dallas – 'FC Dallas Unveils New "DNA Kit" Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: Returning for 2026, the Apple TV sleeve patch appears on the left sleeve of both FC Dallas jerseys.

summary: The Inferno Kit continues as the club's secondary jersey for 2026-27. The club's 2026 kit announcement names UT Southwestern Medical Center as its front-of-jersey partner and the Apple TV patch on the left sleeve of both jerseys; no other sponsor placement is named for the Inferno Kit.
